IN THE COURT OF HON’BLE III ADDITIONAL JUNIOR CIVIL JUDGE-CUM, III ADDITIONAL JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE OF FIRST-CLASS AT KUSHAIGUDA

Honoured Sir/Madam,
The Brief facts facts of the case are the on 22.09.2023 at 00:30hrs received a petition from Sri Rajanala Raju S/o Yadaiah, Age:45yrs, Caste:Mudiraj, Occ:Driver, R/o:H No.2-31, Yadgarpally (V), Keesara Mandal, Medchal Malkajgiri dist In his petition, the complainant stated that his daughter, namely Rajanala Nandini, age:20 years, is pursuing her first year Degree at Sai Sudheer College, ECIL. On 21.09.2026 at about 07:30 hours, she left their house as usual to attend college. However, she did not return home in the evening. As the missing woman did not possess a mobile phone, the complainant went to her college and enquired about her whereabouts. The college authorities informed him that she had not attended college on that day and was marked absent. Later, on the same day at about 20:15 hours, the complainant received a phone call from an unknown mobile number, i.e., 8977473269. During the said call, his daughter Rajanala Nandini informed him that she was safe and requested him not to search for her. Thereafter, she disconnected the call. When the complainant subsequently attempted to contact the said mobile number, it was found to be switched off. Hence,he had requested to take necessary action as per law.

Received on 22.09.2026 at 00:30 Hours 
  As Per the Contents of the above Petition, I B Nagaraju SI of Police PS Keesara registered a case in Cr. No: 947/2026 U/s Woman Missing and investigation entrusted to P. Bala Narsimha ASI .
                                                              Station House Officer
                                                                            PS Keesara. Malkajgiri.
